messages:
maria_gonzalez: FYI partner just surfaced an oddity: their edge gateways buffer usage and then bulk-commit after connectivity returns. A bunch of those commits land ~30-50m late and show up as "pending" in our staging ledger.
ajay_sinha: Do we have an incident or is this just a validation fail?
kevin_thomas: Not an incident yet. Repro looks like a TTL vs dedupe window problem. If gateway retries after our dedupe window, we drop it as a duplicate.
tina_ops: billing-bot: STAGING ALERT: 4 affected accounts, ~12k token-equivalent underreporting detected.
maria_gonzalez: Partner has a small local queue (in-memory) to save flash cycles. They can increase retention but worried about storage and battery.
devon_partners: Yeah, we prefer server-side fixes if possible. Changing device firmware takes months.
ajay_sinha: Short-term: we can widen the dedupe window for events from that partner namespace. Medium-term: add a reprocess endpoint to accept late arrivals with original_event_ts and event_id.
kevin_thomas: Reprocess approach would require: event_id, original_timestamp, reported_at, units, sku, and a signed proof. We'll need to decide semantics for rollups and entitlements.
tina_ops: We also need an ops guard against double-crediting. If reprocess accepts older events we must ensure idempotency and a reconciliation job to recompute hourly aggregations.
maria_gonzalez: Suggestion: 1) Toggle FF to bump dedupe from 5m -> 1h for partner-namespace (quick). 2) Prototype reprocess API and schema. 3) Update reconciliation playbook to handle retroactive events.
ajay_sinha: I can ship a namespaced FF in marketplace-ingest tonight. Low blast radius, feature-flagged. I'll add a metric for duplicate-credits.% and an auto-rollback trigger.
kevin_thomas: Drafting API example in RFC now. Example payload as a single string in thread (we'll attach formal spec later):
```json
{
  "event_id": "edge-uuid-20260323-0001",
  "original_timestamp": "2026-03-23T08:42:10Z",
  "reported_at": "2026-03-23T09:25:34Z",
  "units": 256,
  "sku": "edge-sku-1",
  "signature": "base64sig"
}
```
devon_partners: Partner can run a replay against a test endpoint tomorrow. They will send 5k delayed events to validate dedupe widen + reprocess acceptance.
tina_ops: Ops checklist for FF rollout: monitor ingest success rate, duplicates rate, ledger drift. If duplicates > 0.2% for 15m, we rollback. Also run a smoke reconciliation for affected accounts after the replay.
ajay_sinha: I'll create a tiny RFC: "namespaced dedupe-window + reprocess endpoint" and link the draft here. Also will enable FF for dev partner by EOD.
kevin_thomas: I'll add unit/integration tests covering: late arrival acceptance, hourly rollup recompute, entitlement delta application, and prevention of duplicate credits via event_id idempotency.
maria_gonzalez: I'll coordinate partner test schedule and provide a verification checklist: pre-count, live replay, post-count, ledger reconciliation diff. Will post results here.
devon_partners: Scheduling replay for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Will ping once queued. :thumbsup:
kevin_thomas: Action items recap: Ajay - FF + monitor/rollback; Kevin - RFC + API draft + tests; Maria - partner coordination + verification checklist; Tina - ops rollback guard + reconciliation smoke; Partner (Devon) - replay test.
maria_gonzalez: Thanks all. Posting follow-up after the test run with pass/fail and any next steps.
